**Item Scrolling** is here 🖱️
Move items by scrolling instead of clicking — one item, a whole stack, or the entire inventory, and every control is yours to bind.

The menu grew up, too: settings **unfold right out of their card**, the HUD editor **won't let elements collide**, and Club quietly **stops drawing what you can't see**.

• 🖱️ Item Scrolling — *beta*
• 🎛️ Settings that drop out of their card
• 🖥️ HUD editor with no overlapping elements
• ⚡ Off-screen culling + a background-FPS throttle
